figures.caption: Solvent accessible molecular surfaces using a probe of 1.4 Å (water molecule radius). The peptides are presented in stick models, where hydrogen atoms are in white, oxygens in red, nitrogen atoms in blue, sulfur in orange, and carbon atoms in gray. The molecular surfaces are translucid and presented in yellow color (Discovery Studio Visualizer 4.0 program, Accelrys Software Inc., 2005–2013, San Diego, CA, USA).
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Maps of electrostatic potential (MPEs) were calculated onto the molecular surface of PS3 and PS5 peptides. Regarding the color range, higher electronic density distribution regions are displayed as intense red color (−0.159), and lower electronic density distribution regions are shown in intense blue color (+0.169) (Gaussian 03W, Gaussian, Inc., Pittsburgh, PA, USA, 2003; GaussView 05, Gaussian, Inc., Pittsburgh, PA, USA, 2002–2008).
